title: Codex is dropping plan mode. No date yet.
friendlyTitle: Codex is removing plan mode. It has not said when.
summary: On 15 November, an OpenAI maintainer wrote on a Codex GitHub issue that plan mode will be deprecated soon, and that the team will not add new plan-mode features. The issue, a request to compact the context before implementing a plan, was closed as not planned. The comment does not give a date, or say what replaces the step.
friendlySummary: On 15 November, an OpenAI maintainer wrote on GitHub that Codex plan mode will be removed soon. The team will not add new features to it. The note does not give a date, or say what replaces the step. The request it was answering was closed.
whyItMatters: Plan mode is the pause where Codex writes a plan before it edits. If you use that pause to catch a bad approach, the next build may not offer it. Until the change lands, the current buttons still work. A missing date is not a shutdown notice.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Plan mode is the pause where Codex writes a plan before it changes the code. If you use that pause to catch a bad idea, the next version may not have it. Until then, the current buttons still work. No date does not mean it stopped today.
